name: Splunk — IOC hunting
description: SPL searches built on Common Information Model field names, so they work on any sourcetype that is CIM compliant. Adjust the index variable to your environment before running.

match.note: Add your on-premise search head as a custom target in SOCx settings.

variables.label: Index
variables.description: Narrow this down: index=* on a large deployment is slow and expensive.

variables.label: tstats: summaries only
variables.description: Fast and safe, but excludes data outside the accelerated summary range.

variables.label: tstats: allow old summaries
variables.description: Include summaries created before the current data model definition.

templates.name: Network traffic towards the indicators
templates.description: CIM Network Traffic fields. Matches the indicator as destination or source.
templates.body:
index={{var:index}} earliest=-{{var:range}}
  (dest_ip {{op}} ({{iocs}}) OR src_ip {{op}} ({{iocs}}))
| stats count AS events, min(_time) AS first_seen, max(_time) AS last_seen,
        values(dest_port) AS ports, values(action) AS actions
        BY src_ip, dest_ip, sourcetype
| convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen)
| sort - events

templates.name: Proxy requests to the indicators
templates.description: CIM Web data model fields, covering both the host header and the full URL.
templates.body:
index={{var:index}} earliest=-{{var:range}}
| search {{field}} {{op}} ({{iocs}})
| table _time, src, user, {{field}}, http_method, status, bytes_out, http_user_agent
| sort - _time

templates.name: Proxy requests containing the domains
templates.description: Substring variant for when the logged URL carries a path and the exact match above returns nothing.
templates.body:
index={{var:index}} earliest=-{{var:range}}
| regex url="{{iocs|regex}}"
| table _time, src, user, url, http_method, status, bytes_out, http_user_agent
| sort - _time

templates.name: DNS resolutions of the domains
templates.description: CIM Network Resolution. Shows which client asked for the domain and what it got back.

templates.name: Endpoint events matching the hashes
templates.description: Searches each hash inline as an indexed term, then coalesces common hash fields for display. This is the reliable generic fallback when no single CIM field is populated consistently.
templates.body:
index={{var:index}} earliest=-{{var:range}} ({{iocs|or-terms}})
| eval matched_hash=coalesce(process_hash, file_hash, SHA256, SHA1, MD5, hash)
| table _time, host, user, process_name, process, parent_process_name, file_path, matched_hash, sourcetype
| sort - _time

templates.name: Indicators appearing in a command line
templates.description: Keyword search restricted to events that expose the CIM process field. This avoids a regex scan while still catching downloaders and exfiltration one-liners.
templates.body:
index={{var:index}} earliest=-{{var:range}} process=* ({{iocs|or-terms}})
| table _time, host, user, parent_process_name, process_name, process, sourcetype
| sort - _time

templates.name: Authentications from the IP addresses
templates.description: CIM Authentication. Splits successes from failures per account, so a successful spray stands out.
templates.body:
index={{var:index}} earliest=-{{var:range}}
| search {{field}} {{op}} ({{iocs}})
| stats count AS attempts,
        count(eval(action="success")) AS successes,
        count(eval(action="failure")) AS failures,
        values(app) AS apps
        BY user, src
| where successes > 0
| sort - successes

templates.name: Accelerated traffic lookup (tstats)
templates.description: Runs across the indexes represented by the Network Traffic data model. Use the checkboxes to choose summary-only speed versus unsummarized coverage.
templates.body:
| tstats summariesonly={{var:summariesonly}} allow_old_summaries={{var:allow-old-summaries}} count, min(_time) AS first_seen, max(_time) AS last_seen
  FROM datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic
  WHERE earliest=-{{var:range}} (All_Traffic.dest_ip {{op}} ({{iocs}}) OR All_Traffic.src_ip {{op}} ({{iocs}}))
  BY All_Traffic.src_ip, All_Traffic.dest_ip, All_Traffic.dest_port
| rename All_Traffic.* AS *
| convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen)
| sort - count

templates.name: Accelerated process hash lookup (tstats)
templates.description: Fast, CIM-normalised lookup in Endpoint.Processes. Use the generic endpoint hash query when the data is not mapped or the hash field is not populated.
templates.body:
| tstats summariesonly={{var:summariesonly}} allow_old_summaries={{var:allow-old-summaries}} count, min(_time) AS first_seen, max(_time) AS last_seen
  FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
  WHERE earliest=-{{var:range}} {{field}} {{op}} ({{iocs}})
  BY Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name, Processes.process, Processes.process_hash
| rename Processes.* AS *
| convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen)
| sort - count

templates.name: Broad IOC term sweep in the selected index
templates.description: Last-resort indexed term search when the source field is unknown. It avoids regex over _raw, but can still be expensive: keep the index and time range narrow.
templates.body:
index={{var:index}} earliest=-{{var:range}} ({{iocs|or-terms}})
| stats count, min(_time) AS first_seen, max(_time) AS last_seen BY index, sourcetype, host
| convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen)
| sort - count
